svg.title: Systems engineering, software, and security
svg.desc: Software engineer with a systems focus and full-stack experience. Interested in low-latency media and control, concurrent event processing, distributed messaging, crypto networks, and parallel state-space search. Native clients, backend services, and the protocols between them: scheduling, message ordering, backpressure, and idempotency under load. UAV firmware, ground-control interfaces, and live video/telemetry relays with custom input handling. VPNs, secure tunnels, self-hosted networks, and agentic harnesses. Research interests: Windows internals, privilege escalation, browser sandbox escapes, firmware reversing, and code-execution chains. Authentication bypasses, WAF/parser differentials, protocol abuse, and automated reconnaissance. Tools: Burp Suite, Nmap, ffuf, Nuclei, Ghidra, WinDbg. Stack: Rust / Tokio · Go / Gin; Elixir / Phoenix / OTP; C++23 / Win32 / D3D11; Python / FastAPI; React · Next.js · Expo; React Native · TypeScript; Broadway · RabbitMQ · AMQP; Media transport · IPC · RPC; SQL · NoSQL · vector stores; Linux · Docker · VMware; Nginx · AWS / GCP; Tailscale · tunneling; MCP · ONNX. 801 contributions, current streak 1 days, longest streak 9 days.
